target.title: fix(cli): keep plugin description truncation UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `openclaw plugins list` could display broken U+FFFD replacement characters when a plugin description contained an emoji or CJK supplementary character at the 57-character truncation boundary.

`plugin.description.slice(0, 57)` cuts at UTF-16 code unit boundaries — emoji like 🚀 are surrogate pairs (2 code units) and get split.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace `plugin.description.slice(0, 57)` with `truncateUtf16Safe(plugin.description, 57)`.

## User Impact

`openclaw plugins list` descriptions containing emoji or CJK near the 60-character limit now display cleanly truncated text.

## Evidence

### Tests

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  3 passed (3)
```

### Files Changed (2 files, +34/-2)

```
 src/cli/plugins-list-description-truncate-utf16.test.ts | 34 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 src/cli/plugins-list-format.ts                          |  4 ++--
```
